title: Courtenay Polymers Pty Limited (trading as ICO Polymers) - proposed acquisition of MicroPellets Australia
acquirers: Courtenay Polymers Pty Limited (trading as ICO Polymers Australia)

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Courtenay Polymers Pty Limited, trading as ICO Polymers, proposed to acquire the assets of MicroPellets Australia.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the competitive effects of the proposed acquisition in the context of the national market for the supply of linear low density polyethylene (LLDPE) powder.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant market. Factors informing this conclusion included: - the presence of a number of competing domestic LLDPE powder suppliers; and - the availability of competitively priced imported LLDPE powder.
